## TASK-017 - Observe current-owner session maintenance

Exercise one representative enabled root session checkpoint using the actual live Director/confirmed owner, with fresh changed-input observation and current usage. Route one eligible bounded operation through its normal owner; report collection, admission, dispatch and completed receipt separately.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-009, REQ-014 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | Verification/integrated-curator-ontology/live-session.json, Verification/integrated-curator-ontology/live-owner-result.json |
| Dependencies | TASK-016 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- A collector or shell process is not a live AI actor; do not create/reopen a Task solely to satisfy an Application constructor.

### Acceptance criteria

- Enabled start/return observation retains changed input and follows current owner rules within configured session budget.
- A representative maintenance operation reaches its applicable current owner and yields attributable completed evidence; unavailable owner/exhausted budget retains pending delivery with exact reason.
- Disabled session control performs no admission; saved ontology or memory never creates an actor, scheduler, new canonical writer or publication scope.
- The checkpoint uses at most one admitted operation, two model calls, 30 seconds, 1,000,000 candidate bytes and three agent slots, subject to lower actual capacity and remaining usage. Collection, admission, dispatch and completed owner outcome have distinct evidence; no delivery is consumed on dispatch alone.

### Planned verification

- Invoke installed session-start in the selected authorized live session and record bounded snapshot/count/page semantics.
- Observe actual native owner identity/current Task gates, dispatch one eligible operation and reread its completed owner receipt; compare transport delivery before/after.
